name: Aldi Ahmad Dani
tagline: I build fast web apps and practical AI tools that people actually use.
bio: I started out building websites for local shops and never stopped. Today I work across the whole stack: React on the front, TypeScript and Python services on the back, and Postgres underneath.
For the last two years most of my work has involved LLMs: retrieval-augmented chatbots, coding assistants, and automation pipelines that turn messy documents into clean data.
I care about the boring parts too: evals, observability, and keeping cloud bills small. Outside of work I tinker with side projects that are mostly excuses to try new tools.
